armed.speaker: defense
armed.text: Defense Secretary: "The skirmish is over. The Kalmar fleet broke formation, but the bill is written in fuel and steel."

sanctions.speaker: state
sanctions.text: Secretary of State: "The sanctions bit harder than expected. Kalmar's fleet is pulling back, but fuel prices at home are spiking."

appeasement.speaker: chief
appeasement.text: Chief of Staff: "The shooting stopped and we kept the peace. The opposition calls it surrender. They are moving to table a vote of no confidence."
